evidence.title: This Auto CEO Sees a Future With More Chinese Parts in American Cars

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. electric-vehicle incentive policy and adoption data
occurrences.quote_span: Incentives can only help in the beginning. They cannot drive a long-term change.
occurrences.speaker: Håkan Samuelsson
occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.quote_span: If you look into what Americans need: number one is more multifuel capability. It cannot be only EVs, it should be multifuels, to leave that choice to the consumer.
occurrences.speaker: Håkan Samuelsson
occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.checkable_against: Volvo Cars product-generation plans and congressional legislative records
occurrences.quote_span: After years of challenges, with more pain on the way, Volvo’s plan for reviving its fortunes rests on a new generation of cars that will lean in to both its Chinese ownership and the American consumer—even as Congress debates a legislative ban on Chinese cars.

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.quote_span: Were you surprised that your Geely-family sister brand Polestar didn’t get approval?

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Commerce Department ICTS approval and exemption records for Volvo Cars
occurrences.quote_span: We needed to show how we treat and handle data coming from connected cars—how do we protect the national interest of the U.S., how does it work, who has access to data from the car, who has access to software and so on. It was a very detailed discussion to show that in this respect we are definitely not a Chinese company. When we had proven that, then we got approval from the Commerce Department.

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.quote_span: If we are fully utilizing the factory, in the medium term, that will create jobs.

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. vehicle registrations and Chinese automaker manufacturing and supplier records
occurrences.quote_span: They could be, but I think [Chinese automakers] really need to be good citizens and build the cars in America, develop the cars in America, use American suppliers.

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.checkable_against: Volvo Cars regional vehicle software and platform specifications
occurrences.quote_span: Our cars in China will be much more Geely-based, while Europe and America will have locally developed Western software systems.

occurrences.quote_span: But in mechanical parts, why not? Why shouldn’t cars in Europe have the same brake caliper or the same air-conditioning compressor as cars in China? And if we can find such common components, we can lower the cost of the hardware.

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.speaker: Håkan Samuelsson
occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.checkable_against: Volvo Cars product architecture and parts-sharing plans
occurrences.quote_span: In a recent interview, veteran Chief Executive Håkan Samuelsson told The Wall Street Journal that Volvo wants to lower costs by sharing more parts with Geely, its majority owner, while also protecting cars sold in the West from being accessed by China.
occurrences.speaker: Håkan Samuelsson
occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.subject: Volvo Cars

occurrences.quote_span: We cannot end up having a factory and not using it.
